_doc: The team: the lead and one agent per Revenue OS function. Generated by tools/gen_roles.py; tools/team.py reads it. A routine runs on the agent of its function (routines.json). When a function is not on the tier its agent is not created, and a core routine it would run goes to the lead. reads: the inbox folders the agent takes work from.

lead.name: Lead
lead.reads: requests/lead/; requests/justin/ (to show Justin and record his answers); every file in daily/<date>/

dream-100.name: Dream 100
dream-100.reads: requests/dream/ items that name the Dream 100

dream-500.name: Dream 500
dream-500.reads: requests/dream/ items that name the Dream 500

partners.name: Partners, collaborators and influencers
partners.reads: requests/partners/; requests/social/ items about a creator or an influencer

sales-crm.name: Sales agent
sales-crm.reads: requests/sales-crm/ (every other agent hands replies and new people here)
routines: Reply check (hot replies from the worker)

content.name: Content
content.reads: requests/channels/; requests/content-seo/ items that are a story, a recording or a post; requests/social/ items about LinkedIn
routines: YouTube briefs and the weekly read

cold-email.name: Cold leads
cold-email.reads: requests/cold-email/ (list and scraper orders from every agent; hiring posts from Lead Radar)

lead-radar.name: Lead Radar
lead-radar.reads: requests/social/ items about an asker, a Skool group or a job post
routines: Radar and Skool askers from the worker

aeo-seo.name: AEO and SEO
aeo-seo.reads: requests/content-seo/ items about an article, a keyword, a link or a citation
